spans.s: चेट, अस्, m. a servant, &c. See s. v.

चेट चेट, अस्, m. (fr. rt. चिट्), a servant, a
slave, (गर्भ-चेट, a slave by birth); (ई), f. a
female servant or slave.

चेटक, अस्, m. a servant, a slave, a minister who
fulfils an appointed duty; a paramour; (इका), f. a
female slave or servant, a servant girl, a little maid-
servant.
